title: Reel Em In Charters LLC - Premier Inshore Fishing Charters
specs: Only Premier fishing charter in the tri-villages of the Outer Banks offering night fishing trips
Captain is US Coast Guard licensed
includes: All necessary safety gear and top of the line tackle and fishing gear
blurb: Guests go on inshore fishing charters targeting species like speckled trout, red drum, sheepshead, black sea bass, bluefish, and Spanish mackerel. Trips include morning and evening fishing with a 21' center console boat equipped with safety gear and top fishing tackle. Captain Mark McGuire is US Coast Guard licensed and offers night fishing trips as well.
extraNote: Captain may cancel trips due to wind or weather conditions for safety · Boat location at 23902 N.C. Highway 12, Rodanthe, North Carolina 27968

quotes.text: Capt. Mark and his mate were awesome! Kept my wife, 11 yr old daughter and myself on a steady bite of trout.. great communication, I had scheduled a second trip, Capt. Mark was concerned about winds for the 2nd trip and not being able to get to his spots. That alone earned our respect and future business. Not many charter Capt. In my experience would rather cancel a trip than get a paycheck. Look forward too future trips with Reel em in!

Captain Mark did a great job helping my family and I. We all had a little fishing experience, but had never fished in Rodanthe, N.C. He was sociable with us and taught us a lot and we landed some fish. Had a blast. Highly recommend for all especially amateur anglers like myself or for a family outing.

Thanks again. This was my daughter’s first fishing trip on a boat and was such a great time catching fish. Captain Mark and Ryan the Mate were Awesome they were so knowledgeable and catered to our every need. The 4 hour charter was perfect. Will definitely be back next year.
